(constant) WKnowledgeRelate

Description:

通用知識關聯套件

提供一輪關聯之完整管線(關聯 → 投影 → 總覽): ① 安裝即用:createKnowledgeRelate({ workDir }) 零注入即可跑,讀摘要套件交出之筆記,預設席位為免金鑰之免費模型 ② 逐層可覆寫:cfg 設定逐鍵覆寫、cfg.data.vocab 型別清單與提示詞之領域句、cfg.prompts 提示詞、cfg.domains 整組 domain、 cfg.stages／stageOpts 子階段與動作鏈 tap(含重評鏈)、cfg.aiAdapter 調度層 ③ 領域中立:主題範圍、知識庫稱呼、關聯型別與衝突型、型別之語意角色皆由安裝方決定 ④ 知識之加入、變更與刪除:新筆記之正向關聯、反向段與候選輪巡擴充關聯;內容變更之重判與既有邊之重評;明示刪除與還原 ⑤ 檢定標準:邊之納入閘與各標準之純函數判定、標準之登記(RELATE_STANDARDS)、存量掃描(auditRelateStandards)與存量處置 (planEdgeStockFix 等)、衝突核對與既有邊覆核之判定小組,供測試與維運檢查功能是否正常 ⑥ 免費 AI 能力評分:四角色(關聯、重評、衝突核對、既有邊覆核)以正式提示詞量模型(runRelateBench、runRelateBenchCli)

Example
import WKnowledgeRelate from 'w-knowledge-relate/src/WKnowledgeRelate.mjs'

//零注入:僅 workDir 必填(金鑰放 workDir/.env;預設 AI 席位為免金鑰之免費模型)
let flow = WKnowledgeRelate.createKnowledgeRelate({
    workDir: './my-kb', //notes 集合中之筆記(摘要套件交出)即本套件之輸入

Example
let domain = createRelateDomain({})
let rows = new Map()
let relations = {
    get: async (id) => rows.get(id) || null,
    insertNew: async (xs) => { xs.forEach((x) => rows.set(x.id, x)); return { addCount: xs.length } },
    patch: async (id, f) => { Object.assign(rows.get(id), f) },
    replace: async (r) => { rows.set(r.id, r) },
}
let edge = makeEdge({ from: 'a', to: 'b', type: domain.relationTypes[0], reason: '兩篇皆以波動度調整部位，屬同一機制之延伸', nowIso: '2026-11-02T00:00:00+08:00' })
let rt = { conflictCheckOn: false, rank: typeRankOf(domain), conflictType: domain.conflictType, mutex: createMutex(), createdThisRun: new Set(), adj: buildAdjacency([]), touchesExtracted: () => false }
let msg = { topic: 'note', data: { _edges: [edge], _rt: rt, _segment: 'forward', _provider: 'p1' }, meta: {}, stats: {} }
let ctx = { deps: { stores: { relations, holds: null }, clock: { iso8: () => '2026-11-02T00:00:00+08:00' } }, log: { info: () => {} } }
let mw = mwPersistEdges()
await mw.handle(msg, ctx, (m) => m)
console.log(mw.name, rows.size, msg.data._edges.length, msg.data._pending.length, msg.stats)
// => persistEdges 1 1 0 { edges: 1 }

classDecisionOf(votes, classOf) → {Object}

Description:

  • 兩層判定之第一層(類別;衝突核對與既有邊覆核同一骨架):各票先映為類別交判定小組(摘要套件之 decidePanel);未成立 → retry(缺票、同一供應者 ——不是真的判不了)／undetermined(不確定、不一致——判不了),並附第三席可否改變結果(needThird);成立 → 類別與成立類別內之票

Source:
  • stores/edgeCheckKit.mjs, line 207
Example
const keep = { verdict: 'keep' }
const retire = { verdict: 'retire' }
const classOf = (v) => (v ? (v.verdict === 'retire' ? 'none' : 'related') : null)
const vote = (seat, provider, verdict) => ({ seat, provider, verdict })

const d1 = classDecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', keep), vote('second', 'b', keep)], classOf)
console.log(d1.decided, d1.cls, d1.votes.length)
// => true related 2

const d2 = classDecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', keep), vote('second', 'b', retire)], classOf)
console.log(d2.decided, d2.action, d2.why, d2.needThird)
// => false undetermined disagree true

const d3 = classDecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', keep), vote('second', 'a', keep)], classOf)
console.log(d3.decided, d3.action, d3.why)
// => false retry same-provider

const d4 = classDecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', keep), vote('second', 'b', null)], classOf)
console.log(d4.decided, d4.action, d4.why)
// => false retry missing

let state = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'rel-'))

    return {
        get: async (id) => m.get(id) || null,
        select: async () => [...m.values()],
        insertNew: async (xs) => { xs.forEach((x) => m.set(x.id, x)); return { addCount: xs.length } },
        patch: async (id, f) => { Object.assign(m.get(id), f) },
        del: async (id) => m.delete(id),
    }
}

    stores: { notes: mem([{ id: 'a', title: '甲' }, { id: 'b', title: '乙' }]), relations: mem([edge]) },
    dirs: { state },
    clock: { iso8: () => '2026-11-02T00:00:00+08:00', stamp8: () => '20261102' },

const m = new Map()

    get: async (id) => m.get(id) ?? null,
    insertNew: async (rows) => { rows.forEach((r) => m.set(r.id, r)); return { addCount: rows.length } },
    patch: async (id, v) => { m.set(id, { ...m.get(id), ...v }) },
    replace: async (r) => { m.set(r.id, r) },
}
const first = makeEdge({ from: 'a', to: 'b', type: '甲', reason: '理由', nowIso: 'T1' })
const r1 = await persistEdge(relations, first, {})
const r2 = await persistEdge(relations, first, {})

// => true true false false 1

const { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, readFileSync, rmSync } = await import('fs')
const { join } = await import('path')
const { tmpdir } = await import('os')
const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'proj-'))
const notes = ['n1', 'n2'].map((id) => {
    const file = join(dir, `${id}.md`)
    writeFileSync(file, `---\ntitle: "${id}"\n---\n\n# ${id}\n\n## 核心知識\n\n- 要點\n`, 'utf8')
    return { id, title: `標題${id}`, file }
})
const edges = [{ id: 'e1', from: 'n1', to: 'n2', type: '前置概念', reason: '理由甲', createdAt: 'T1' }]
const patched = []
const deps = {
    stores: {
        notes: { select: async () => notes, patch: async (id, v) => { patched.push(`${id}:${v.relatedCount}`) } },
        relations: { select: async () => edges },
    },
    dirs: { state: dir },
    clock: { stamp8: () => '20261005' },
    domain: { relationTypes: ['前置概念'], conflictType: '衝突' },
}
const det = await projectNotes(deps, ['n1', 'n2', 'n9'])
console.log(det.projected, det.changed, det.failed, det.gone, det.manual, patched)
// => 2 2 0 1 0 [ 'n1:1', 'n2:1' ]
console.log(readFileSync(notes[1].file, 'utf8').includes('- [前置概念] ← [[n1]] 標題n1：理由甲'))
// => true
rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })

reservedCallOf(ask, sub, firstMs) → {function}

Description:

  • 扣保留之段之呼叫(正向、反向、輪巡、重評、既有邊覆核、衝突核對同一份;包在 relateAiCallOf 之外): ①進門:扣保留後不足開工門檻(firstMs)→ 不送出,回 skipped(與調度層進門即回 ABORTED 同義;不計此次之失敗); ②鏈內:交調度層之 shouldStop 以鏈內續派門檻(chainStepMsOf)判——主席失敗(含等滿逾時)後仍續派遞補, 各次嘗試之逾時由 budgetMs(＝進門當下之剩餘−保留;相對預算,於調度層起算時才開始計)封頂,使遞補不致侵入保留; ③失敗之歸類不另判:中止、預算用盡與「被截止切斷之末家」由調度層之結果(errorType、嘗試之間之 shouldStop)歸為 skipped; 各家皆試過而真的失敗者照計失敗(不因此刻剩餘不足開工門檻而改標 skipped);惟轉接層於失敗後仍以鏈內 shouldStop 判斷是否被截止切斷, 故此刻剩餘已低於續派門檻者同樣視為中止

console.log((await reservedCallOf(ask, sub, 360000)('p', () => true, {})).ok)
// => true

restoreEdge(deps, id, optopt) → {Promise}

Description:

  • 依稽核還原一條被撤出之邊(撤出理由須在 RESTORABLE_REASONS;檔頭【restoreEdge】):以該邊最後一筆稽核為準(retiredEdgesOf);兩端皆在、 現值不存在、且過納入閘才重入;預設只列出,apply 才寫(先記待投影 → 寫邊 → AI 標準之處置 → 稽核 restored〔完成之標記〕→ 當場投影)。 還原 AI 標準撤出／隔離之邊＝使用者裁示(須 checks 集合);其餘還原之衝突邊登錄 RS4 待判(檔頭【還原之邊與 AI 標準】)。撤出時之理由本身不合 標準者可給 opt.reason 以新理由還原。

Source:
  • ops/noteOps.mjs, line 1088
Example
let state = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'rel-'))
let mem = (rows) => {
    let m = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]))
    return {
        get: async (id) => m.get(id) || null,
        select: async () => [...m.values()],
        insertNew: async (xs) => { xs.forEach((x) => m.set(x.id, x)); return { addCount: xs.length } },
        patch: async (id, f) => { Object.assign(m.get(id), f) },
        del: async (id) => m.delete(id),
    }
}
let domain = createRelateDomain({})
let edge = makeEdge({ from: 'a', to: 'b', type: domain.relationTypes[0], reason: '兩篇皆以波動度調整部位，屬同一機制之延伸', nowIso: '2026-11-01T00:00:00+08:00' })
let deps = {
    stores: { notes: mem([{ id: 'a', title: '甲' }, { id: 'b', title: '乙' }]), relations: mem([edge]) },
    dirs: { state },
    clock: { iso8: () => '2026-11-02T00:00:00+08:00', stamp8: () => '20261102' },
    log: { info: () => {}, warn: () => {}, error: () => {} },
    domain,
}
await retireEdge({ relations: deps.stores.relations, ledgers: openRelateLedgers(state), stateDir: state }, edge, { reason: 'std-retire', at: '2026-11-01T12:00:00+08:00', conflictTypes: domain.conflictTypeNames, hasNote: () => true, detail: '示範撤出' })
console.log(await deps.stores.relations.get(edge.id))
let pv = await restoreEdge(deps, edge.id)
console.log(pv.found, pv.restorable, pv.applied, pv.retiredAs)
let r = await restoreEdge(deps, edge.id, { apply: true, project: false })
console.log(r.applied, JSON.stringify(r.ruling), (await deps.stores.relations.get(edge.id)).type === domain.relationTypes[0])
console.log((await restoreEdge(deps, edge.id)).reason)
fs.rmSync(state, { recursive: true, force: true })
// => null
// => true true false std-retire
// => true "" true
// => 稽核最後一筆為已還原

    let m = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]))
    return {
        get: async (id) => m.get(id) || null,
        select: async () => [...m.values()],
        patch: async (id, f) => { Object.assign(m.get(id), f) },
        replace: async (r) => { m.set(r.id, r) },
    }
}

let R0 = '兩篇皆以波動度調整部位，屬同一機制之延伸'
let R1 = '甲之波動度目標化提供乙之部位縮放所需之波動度估計'

    domain,
}

appendAudit(file, { at: '2026-11-01T12:00:00+08:00', note: 'a', version: '2026-11-01T00:00:00+08:00', edgeId: edge.id, edge: { from: 'a', to: 'b', type: T0, reason: R0 }, written: { type: T1, reason: R1 }, outcome: 'applied' })
let pv = await revertEdgeRevision(deps, edge.id)
console.log(pv.found, pv.revertible, pv.ledger, pv.std, pv.applied, pv.from.type === T1, pv.to.type === T0)
let r = await revertEdgeRevision(deps, edge.id, { apply: true, project: false })
let cur = await deps.stores.relations.get(edge.id)

console.log((await revertEdgeRevision(deps, edge.id)).reason)
fs.rmSync(state, { recursive: true, force: true })

rs4DecisionOf(votes, conflictType) → {Object}

Description:

  • 兩層判定(兩家皆判非衝突而建議之型別不同,是「改正之型別判不了」,不是「判不了是否衝突」): ①是否真衝突——以類別(conflict／not)交判定小組(edgeCheckKit.classDecisionOf);未成立 → retry(缺票、同一供應者)／undetermined(不確定、不一致)。 ②類別成立後之處置——conflict:成立之票中有 change 衝突型者 → reason(採其新理由;過不了納入閘由呼叫端維持原理由),否則 keep; not:須有兩票(供應者不同)裁決完全相同(同一非衝突型或同為 retire)→ downgrade／retire;否則 not-split(非衝突已定、改正之型別判不了)。

Source:
  • stores/conflictCheckPolicy.mjs, line 164
Example
const keep = { verdict: 'keep', reason: '' }
const down = { verdict: 'change', type: '互補搭配', reason: '兩者各補足對方缺少之條件' }
const other = { verdict: 'change', type: '前置概念', reason: '兩者各補足對方缺少之條件' }
const vote = (seat, provider, verdict) => ({ seat, provider, verdict })

const d1 = rs4DecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', keep), vote('second', 'b', keep)], '衝突或反例')
console.log(d1.action, d1.cls, d1.needThird)
// => keep conflict false

const d2 = rs4DecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', down), vote('second', 'b', down)], '衝突或反例')
console.log(d2.action, d2.cls, d2.verdicts.length)
// => downgrade not 2

const d3 = rs4DecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', down), vote('second', 'b', other)], '衝突或反例')
console.log(d3.action, d3.why, d3.needThird)
// => not-split 改正之型別各席不一致 true

const d4 = rs4DecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', keep), vote('second', 'b', { verdict: 'retire', reason: '兩者並無知識上之關聯' })], '衝突或反例')
console.log(d4.action, d4.why, d4.needThird)
// => undetermined disagree true

const d5 = rs4DecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', keep), vote('second', 'b', null)], '衝突或反例')
console.log(d5.action, d5.why)
// => retry missing

const o = { conflictType: '衝突或反例', current: { type: '同類方法', reason: '兩者皆以優先佇列取出最近之節點' } }

const retire = { verdict: 'retire', reason: '兩者並無知識上之關聯' }
const vote = (seat, provider, verdict) => ({ seat, provider, verdict })

// => keep related 同類方法

console.log(d2.action, d2.cls, d2.type)
// => retype related 實作範例

const d3 = rs6DecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', upgrade), vote('second', 'b', upgrade)], o)
console.log(d3.action, d3.cls, d3.type)
// => upgrade conflict 衝突或反例

const d4 = rs6DecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', retire), vote('second', 'b', retire)], o)
console.log(d4.action, d4.cls)
// => retire none

const d5 = rs6DecisionOf([vote('first', 'a', retype), vote('second', 'b', keep)], o)
console.log(d5.action, d5.why, d5.needThird)
// => type-split 關聯成立而型別各席不一致 true

let list = [{ index: 1, key: 'e1', edge: { id: 'e1' } }, { index: 2, key: 'e2', edge: { id: 'e2' } }]

    list,
    pageSize: 10,
    seats: { first: { use: 'p1' }, second: { use: 'p2' } },
    call: async (spec, prompt, seat) => ({ ok: true, providerId: spec.use, data: [{ index: 1, verdict: 'keep' }, { index: 2, verdict: 'retire' }] }),
    buildPrompt: (items) => items.map((x) => x.index).join(','),
    votesOf: (data, items) => new Map(data.map((d) => [d.index, d.verdict])),
    secondOf: (page) => page,
    ballotOf: (x, a, b) => [a, b],
    decide: (x) => ({ action: x.votes[0].verdict === x.votes[1].verdict ? x.votes[0].verdict : 'retry', needThird: false }),
    shufflePrefix: 'demo',
    shouldStop: () => false,
    log: { info: () => {} },
    label: '示範',
})
console.log(r)
console.log(list.map((x) => `${x.key}:${x.decision.action}:${x.votes.map((v) => v.provider).join('+')}`))
// => { stopped: false, aborted: false, third: 0 }

runConflictCheckSegment(o) → {Promise.<(Object|null)>}

Description:

Source:
  • stages/conflictCheckSegment.mjs, line 132
Example
let dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'rel-'))
let mem = (rows) => {
    let m = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]))
    return {
        get: async (id) => m.get(id) || null,
        select: async (find) => [...m.values()].filter((r) => !find || Object.entries(find).every(([k, v]) => r[k] === v)),
        insertNew: async (xs) => { xs.forEach((x) => m.set(x.id, x)); return { addCount: xs.length } },
        patch: async (id, f) => { Object.assign(m.get(id), f) },
        replace: async (r) => { m.set(r.id, r) },
    }
}
let domain = createRelateDomain({})
let notes = [
    { id: 'n1', title: '標題n1', category: 'c', summary: 'n1 之重點', concepts: ['p'] },
    { id: 'n2', title: '標題n2', category: 'c', summary: 'n2 之重點', concepts: ['p'] },
]
let proposal = makeEdge({ from: 'n1', to: 'n2', type: domain.conflictType, reason: 'n1 說動量有效，n2 說動量於高波動期失效', nowIso: '2026-11-01T00:00:00+08:00' })
let stores = { notes: mem(notes), relations: mem([]), holds: mem([]), checks: mem([]) }
let ctx = {
    deps: { stores, clock: { iso8: () => '2026-11-02T00:00:00+08:00' }, dirs: { state: dir } },
    log: { info: () => {}, warn: () => {} },
}
let rt = {
    adj: buildAdjacency([]),
    byId: new Map(notes.map((n) => [n.id, n])),
    ledgers: openRelateLedgers(dir),
    conflictType: domain.conflictType,
    mutex: createMutex(),
    createdThisRun: new Set(),
    rank: typeRankOf(domain),
    isExtracted: () => false,
    touchesExtracted: () => false,
    pendingConflicts: [{ edge: proposal, proposer: 'p0', segment: 'forward' }],
}
let settings = resolveRelateSettings({
    ai: { parallel: 1 },
    relate: { ai: { use: 'stub:a' }, standards: { conflictCheck: { enabled: true }, ai: { first: { use: 'stub:a' } } } },
})
let callAI = async (prompt, check, c) => ({ ok: true, providerId: 'p1', data: [{ index: 1, verdict: 'keep', reason: '' }], attempts: 1 })
let r = await runConflictCheckSegment({ ctx, rt, domain, settings, ai: null, log: ctx.log, opt: { callAI } })
console.log(r.det.rs4Proposals, r.det.rs4Checked, r.det.rs4Written, r.det.conflicts, r.aiCalls)
console.log((await stores.relations.get(proposal.id))?.type === domain.conflictType)
let off = await runConflictCheckSegment({ ctx, rt, domain, settings: resolveRelateSettings({}), ai: null, log: ctx.log })
console.log(off)
fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
// => 1 1 1 1 1
// => true
// => null

let dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'rel-'))

        get: async (id) => m.get(id) || null,
        select: async (find) => [...m.values()].filter((r) => !find || Object.entries(find).every(([k, v]) => r[k] === v)),
        patch: async (id, f) => { Object.assign(m.get(id), f) },
        replace: async (r) => { m.set(r.id, r) },
    }
}

let n1 = { id: 'n1', title: '標題n1', category: 'c', summary: 'n1 之重點', concepts: ['p'], file: path.join(dir, 'n1.md'), relatedAt: V, relatedChangeAt: V, knowledgeChangedAt: V }
let n2 = { id: 'n2', title: '標題n2', category: 'c', summary: 'n2 之重點', concepts: ['p'] }
let edge = makeEdge({ from: 'n1', to: 'n2', type: domain.relationTypes[0], reason: 'n1 與 n2 共用同一組參數', nowIso: '2026-10-01T00:00:00+08:00' })
let notes = [n1, n2]
let stores = { notes: mem(notes), relations: mem([edge]), holds: mem([]) }
let ctx = {
    deps: { stores, clock: { iso8: () => '2026-11-02T00:00:00+08:00' }, dirs: { state: dir } },
    log: { info: () => {}, warn: () => {} },
}
let rt = { adj: buildAdjacency([edge]), byId: new Map(notes.map((n) => [n.id, n])), ledgers: openRelateLedgers(dir), conflictType: domain.conflictType, mutex: createMutex() }
let settings = resolveRelateSettings({ ai: { parallel: 1 }, relate: { ai: { use: 'stub:a' }, reeval: { perRun: 1, ai: { second: { use: 'stub:b' } } } } })
let callAI = async (prompt, check, c) => ({ ok: true, providerId: c.seat === 'first' ? 'p1' : 'p2', data: [{ index: 1, verdicts: [{ to: 'n2', verdict: 'keep' }] }], attempts: 1 })
let r = await runReevalSegment({ ctx, rt, domain, settings, ai: null, allNotes: notes, log: ctx.log, opt: { callAI } })
console.log(r.det.reevalPending, r.det.reevalCompleted, r.aiCalls, r.fail, (await stores.notes.get('n1')).edgesReviewedChangeAt === V)
let off = await runReevalSegment({ ctx, rt, domain, settings: resolveRelateSettings({}), ai: null, allNotes: notes, log: ctx.log })
console.log(off)
fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
// => 1 1 2 0 true

writeEdge(relations, edge) → {Promise}

Description:

  • 更新一條既有邊:patch(單次原子寫入之合併)→ 回讀比對;不符即 replace 再驗

Source:
  • stores/edgeStore.mjs, line 372
Example
const m = new Map()
const relations = {
    get: async (id) => m.get(id) ?? null,
    patch: async (id, v) => { m.set(id, { ...m.get(id), ...v }) },
    replace: async (r) => { m.set(r.id, r) },
}
const edge = makeEdge({ from: 'a', to: 'b', type: '甲', reason: '理由', nowIso: 'T1' })
m.set(edge.id, edge)
await writeEdge(relations, { ...edge, reason: '新理由' })
console.log((await relations.get(edge.id)).reason)
// => 新理由
